prompt: From the top of Primrose Hill, behind a row of people in sleeping bags sitting along the benches, looking out over London: every park, square and playing field in sight is grey with tents, and smoke from thousands of small fires lies over the city in a flat haze. Flat grey overcast winter daylight in a near-future Britain, muted cold colour, drizzle in the air; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
